def card(work):
    W, H = (600, 400)
    img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), (236, 236, 236))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    ground = int(H * 0.85)
    d.line([(0, ground), (W, ground)], fill=(110, 110, 110), width=2)
    d.rectangle([380, ground - 60, 400, ground], fill=(80, 80, 80))
    d.rectangle([410, ground - 14, 424, ground], fill=(46, 125, 140))
    img.save(work / 'scene.png')
    a = np.asarray(img).astype(int)
    ink = np.abs(a - 236).sum(-1) > 30
    top_empty = not ink[:int(H * 2 / 3)].any()
    rgb = a.reshape(-1, 3)
    colourful = rgb[rgb.max(1) - rgb.min(1) > 20]
    teal_ok = len(colourful) > 0 and np.all(np.abs(colourful - [46, 125, 140]).max(1) <= 2)
    ys, xs = np.where(ink[:ground - 2])
    subj_cx = xs.mean() / W
    template = 'Quiet pencil sketch, greyscale, <subject> small on a ground line, one <prop> in teal, empty sky, no text.'
    filled = template.replace('<subject>', 'a fisherman seen from behind').replace('<prop>', 'bucket')
    return [_c('top two thirds empty', top_empty, top_empty), _c('the only colour is the teal #2E7D8C prop', teal_ok, len(colourful)), _c('subject sits off-centre', abs(subj_cx - 0.5) > 0.1, round(subj_cx, 2)), _c('only the <...> slots of the template changed', filled.replace('a fisherman seen from behind', '<subject>').replace('bucket', '<prop>') == template, '')]

def card(work):
    N = 1024

    def icon(art_frac):
        img = Image.new('RGB', (N, N))
        a = np.zeros((N, N, 3), np.uint8)
        t = np.linspace(0, 1, N)[:, None]
        a[...] = np.c_[20 + 40 * t, 30 + 60 * t, 90 + 100 * t].astype(np.uint8)[:, None, :].repeat(N, 1)
        img = Image.fromarray(a)
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        s = int(N * art_frac)
        o = (N - s) // 2
        d.rounded_rectangle([o, o + s // 4, o + s, o + s], radius=s // 10, fill=(250, 245, 235))
        d.rectangle([o + s // 2 - 6, o + s // 4, o + s // 2 + 6, o + s], fill=(240, 140, 0))
        return img

    def art_fraction(img):
        a = np.asarray(img).astype(int)
        light = a.sum(-1) > 600
        orange = (a[..., 0] > 200) & (a[..., 2] < 50)
        ys, xs = np.where(light | orange)
        return (xs.max() - xs.min() + 1) / N
    good, big = (icon(0.6), icon(0.78))
    good.save(work / 'icon_1024.png')
    sizes = {}
    for px in (256, 64, 16):
        good.resize((px, px), Image.LANCZOS).save(work / f'icon_{px}.png')
        sizes[px] = (work / f'icon_{px}.png').stat().st_size
    fg, fb = (art_fraction(good), art_fraction(big))
    return [_c('canvas 1024x1024', good.size == (1024, 1024), good.size), _c('artwork fills ~60% of the width', abs(fg - 0.6) < 0.01, round(fg, 3)), _c('the 78% variant is flagged as oversized', fb > 0.7 and (not abs(fb - 0.6) < 0.05), round(fb, 3)), _c('previews rendered at 256, 64 and 16', all((v > 0 for v in sizes.values())), sizes)]
